title: Control Plane stitchboard — weekly check-in and tactical notes
content:
Meeting: Control Plane stitchboard — weekly tactical check (Standup replacement this week)
Date: 2026-11-05
Attendees: Amara (owner), Diego, Priya, Samir, Lena, + Ad-hoc: Nadir (SRE)
Location: #plt-controlplane Slack; Notes captured by Amara (working draft)

TL;DR:
- Routing experiments are making steady progress; allocator patch reduced cold-starts by ~18% in canary.
- Auth token refresh regressions resurfaced for edge V2 clients; hotfix deployed to canary, rollout paused pending QA.
- Quota accounting gap: a small subset of batch jobs were double-counted during the peak window on 2026-11-03; investigating upstream consumer ack path.
- Action-heavy week: need owners on PLT-4123 and PLT-4187; several follow-ups carry over to next sprint.

Highlights / Quick metrics (last 72h):
- Median control-plane API latency (PATCH /alloc): 72ms (canary), 95ms (stable) — allocator changes reduced tail in canary.
- Auth token refresh failures: spiked to 1.6% (from baseline 0.02%) between 03:10-03:45 UTC on 2026-11-03.
- Quota discrepancy window: 03:00-04:00 UTC on 2026-11-03 — ~4k requests affected (~0.07% of daily throughput).
- Canary error budget consumption: 4.1% used (target <10% per week).

DECISIONS MADE:
- Pause global rollout of auth-refresh v2 until integration tests include legacy client patterns (Priya owning).
- Proceed with allocator kernel change rollout to 25% of capacity for next 48h, monitor cold-start and preemption metrics (Diego).

OPEN RISKS / BLOCKERS:
- Quota double-count root cause unknown: could be consumer retry loop + idempotency key collision, or delayed ack in SQS layer. Low confidence on hypothesis. (Samir + SRE to triage).
- Observability gap for legacy TLS renegotiation paths — we need a short-term trace point in auth proxy to capture token lifecycle events. (Lena to prototype).

NOTES BY SUBSYSTEM:
1) Control plane (orchestration / alloc):
- Experiment: allocator/pull/129 reduced cold-starts by approx 18% in synthetic stress test. Observed side-effect: slightly higher CPU utilization on allocator agents (small, within headroom).
- Action: Diego to open follow-up PR to add throttled backoff when preemption hits >5/min to avoid oscillation. Target: PR by 2026-11-08.
- TODO: Add a dashboard tile for allocation preemption rate per cluster (low effort, high signal).

2) Routing (traffic shaping / fallbacks):
- Routing policy tweak (weighting by latency percentiles) tested in sim; saw 6% fewer reroutes under tail load.
- Note: need to validate that routing policy respects per-customer quotas before shipping (integration test gap flagged).
- Follow-up: create a canary that simulates quota-exhaustion behavior (Samir to build load harness).

3) Auth (token lifecycle, proxy):
- Regression: auth-refresh v2 created an unexpected NPE for legacy client header set. Hotfix applied to canary (reverted the header normalization).
- Root-cause hypothesis: header set normalization introduced ordering assumptions for nested JWT proxies.
- Decision: stop global rollout until test coverage expanded to include legacy-headers suite and at least 3 production-like client stubs. Priya to coordinate.
- Short-term mitigation: increase sampling of auth-proxy traces and push rule to capture full header snapshots for requests hitting /token-refresh.

4) Quotas (accounting / billing signals):
- Incident: double-counting for a subset of large batch jobs during 03:00-04:00 on 2026-11-03. Preliminary trace shows duplicate acknowledgement from consumer side combined with a delayed commit path.
- Mitigation in progress: a backfill job is being prepared to reconcile quota ledgers and regenerate accurate billing events. Backfill plan: snapshot reconciliation + idempotent event emit. (Lena + Billing team).
- Action: Samir to file a detailed postmortem draft (PLT-4187) due 2026-11-10 with timeline, root cause, and prevention plan (idempotency keys + stronger consumer ACK semantics).

ACTION ITEMS (owner — due):
- AI-01: Diego — add allocator preemption backoff PR and test; due 2026-11-08. Linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/allocator/pull/129
- AI-02: Priya — expand auth integration tests to include legacy header permutations; report progress by 2026-11-09. Linked ticket PLT-4123.
- AI-03: Samir + SRE (Nadir) — triage quota double-count evidence, capture consumer ack flow and retry loop; initial findings by 2026-11-06 EOD.
- AI-04: Lena — prototype auth-proxy tracepoint and dashboard for token lifecycle; demo in next standup (2026-11-12).
- AI-05: Amara — coordinate cross-team postmortem review session and add backfill runbook to runbook page; schedule by 2026-11-07.

MEETING MINUTES / THREAD NOTES (raw):
- Samir: "saw 2x repeated commit messages in the consumer logs, might be a concurrency issue on our batching consumer"
- Priya: "we shipped auth-refactor quickly to fix perf, missed a legacy header edge case — my bad, adding more tests now"
- Diego: "allocator change looks promising; let's avoid large blast radius and monitor preemption sensors"
- Lena: "billing backfill needs validation windows — can't double-apply fixes, we need dry-run mode"

QUICK CHECKLIST / REMINDERS (notes to self):
- Add noisy-key filter on the auth-proxy traces to avoid PII leakage.
- Confirm SLA doc pointers before postmortem (link to runbook above).
- Run the backfill in dry-run against test ledger and produce artifact for review.

BACKGROUND LINKS & HELPERS:
- Canary logs: s3://redwood-logs/controlplane/canary/2026-11-03/* (internal)
- Allocator PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/allocator/pull/129
- Platform PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/847
- Jira: PLT-4123 (auth test gaps), PLT-4187 (quota double-count incident)

NEXT STEPS / NEXT MEETING:
- Next sync: 2026-11-12 (regular weekly standup). Expect short checkpoint on allocator metrics and first cut of auth integration tests.
- Pre-meeting ask: owners to drop one-line status in the thread by 2026-11-10 so we can prioritize backlog for sprint planning.

END NOTES (draft style):
- This doc is intentionally conversational — use as canonical working notes for the week. Add edits inline and tag owner for follow-ups.
- If you see mismatched metrics or need logs, DM me in #plt-controlplane and I'll dump S3 paths.

——
